game.title: GRAYBOX XY ENGINE V2
game.description: A premium 2.5D side-scrolling action RPG where a lone explorer fights through lush jungle ruins, interconnected caverns and floating platform arenas to activate a mysterious Nexus Portal. Combines tight action combat, platforming traversal and loot-driven progression with quest-driven exploration and layered 2.5D presentation.

plan.title: JUNGLE RUINS TO NEXUS PORTAL
plan.gameplay_summary: Traverse segments of jungle-ruin levels, fight & platform past enemies and hazards, open chests/collect loot and complete objectives; return to hubs/checkpoints to upgrade gear, pick new quests, then push deeper to next ruin or Nexus node. Repeat with improved abilities to access new routes, shortcuts and the Nexus.

spec.title: GRAYBOX XY ENGINE V2
spec.description: A premium 2.5D side-scrolling platform adventure: descend through ancient jungle ruins into torch-lit caves, climb the great pyramid, defeat the Jungle Titan and cross the Nexus into a floating realm among the stars.
spec.subject: Game / Action-Adventure
spec.learning_objective: Practice tactical decision-making, pattern recognition in combat, resource management (inventory/upgrades), and spatial navigation through layered platforming and branching routes.
spec.controls: ◀ ▶ run · ⬆/Space jump (double jump!) · ⚔ attack · ✦ ability · ➠ dodge · keyboard + gamepad on desktop

achievement_metadata.label: Explorer's Mark — find all secret chambers in Level 1
Guardian Vanquisher — defeat Temple Colossus without taking damage
Portal Master — activate all Nexus Portals in a playthrough
Speedrunner — beat Level 2 under target time

worlds: Jungle Surface & Ruins — lush plants, layered parallax with distant pyramids and vines
Underground Caverns & Tombs — dimly lit tunnels, bioluminescent flora, lava/acid pockets
Pyramid Summit — wind-swept terraces, floating platform clusters and ancient machinery
Nexus Realm (space/portal plane) — surreal glowing architecture, starscape background, portal nodes
maps: Connected side-scrolling node map per level with multiple branches: primary path, upper path, lower tunnel and secret shortcut nodes
Level flow includes checkpoints at ~25% intervals, chest nodes near branching junctions and portal nodes at level ends
Map gating uses keys/abilities to open sealed routes and requires backtracking to access new areas after upgrades
Floating-platform sections designed with rhythm and precision spacing informed by Reference Image 2 (approximate platform lengths and air gaps)

warnings: 3 required asset(s) will use runtime placeholder art
Save system: runtime game_progress saves — compatible
